From the summit to the front row.

Arenas, meeting rooms, the Day Lodge and the hill. Every space in 360°, in every set-up and every season.

88 Canada Olympic Road SW, Calgary

Set-up

Help

Finding your way

  • Drag to look around. Scroll or pinch to zoom.
  • Press a label on the aerial to drop into that place.
  • Meetings & Events and Explore list every space.
  • The switch at the bottom changes the set-up. The view stays where you were looking.
  • The map button opens the floor plan. Press a pin to go there.
